## Upstream sync: `aeonfun/aeon` `8b8d719..3b4c5a3`

**34 commits** (2026-08-26 → 2026-08-31) · **91 applied** (19 added · 71 updated · 1 auto-merged) · **8 manual** · baseline → `3b4c5a3`.

### Applied cleanly

- **New skills:** `cortx-reliability` (x402 endpoint reliability check, #954) — plus the two held back from the 08-25 sync are **landed here too**: `rightstack`, `skill-article`. The eyebrow v0.4.1 integrity scan (SHA256-pinned binary, scrubbed env) ran in-run this time, so their lockfile coverage and catalog entries are generated instead of deferred to you.
- **Modified skills:** `changelog` (em/en-dash scrub #1000), `deploy-uni-hook` (Labs routing classes #991 + fleet audit rules #992), `skill-repair` (#997 semantics).
- **Auto-merged (3-way):** `skills/skill-health/SKILL.md` — your local edits kept, upstream's `fix-pending` lifecycle (#997: don't resolve an issue when the repair PR is only opened; reconcile fix-pending on real PR state) applied on top. Review the merged hunks.
- **Scripts / harness:** new adapters `cursor.sh` + `hermes.sh` (#967, with headless-workspace trust #983 and api-error fail #984), `envelope.sh` fail-on-unparseable-output (#987), `secretcurl` transient-xAI retry (#989), `notify-deliver` Telegram reply-to-previous-skill-run (#995), new `skill-health-routing.mjs` + 8 test scripts, `notify_format` chunk bounding (#970), `health_issue`/`state_store`/`resolve-harness`/`install-harness` fixes.
- **Workflows:** `chain-runner.yml` — unique run correlation for dispatched skills (#988).
- **Dashboard / apps:** GitHub-auth connect flow (`gh` token → `GH_GLOBAL` copy #993, exact-origin-match #986), new harness auth rows, mcp-server single-flight async queue (#973), CLI auth fix (#971), `bin/add-skill` provenance (#972).
- **Docs / other:** `docs/harnesses.md`, `telegram-commands.md`, `CAPABILITIES`/`CONFIGURATION`/`ECOSYSTEM`, `.claude/skills/aeon/**` + `plugin/skills/aeon/**` reference sync, harness banner re-render (#981).
- **Regenerated from the synced tree (never copied):** `catalog/skills.json` (84 skills), `catalog/packs.json`, `catalog/skill-icons.json` (+2 glyphs: `rightstack` = upstream's entry; `cortx-reliability` = composed locally, upstream ships none — worth contributing upstream), `eyebrowlock.json` (scan + `eyebrow verify`: OK), `apps/dashboard/lib/skill-icons.data.ts`, 84 SVGs. `AGENTS.md` regen came out byte-identical to HEAD — nothing in this PR — and regenerating it clears the 13-day uncommitted-deletion anomaly in the working tree.

### Needs manual review (conflicts — your local copy diverges from upstream)

1. **`scripts/llm-gateway.sh`** — the one that matters. You pinned GLM by hand in `b054cb0` during the 08-31 gateway outage; upstream then shipped the same feature properly (`a80f70f` + `47d1a56`): `glm` as a NATIVE gateway arm, secret fallback `GLM_API_KEY` → `ZAI_API_KEY`, base `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`, and **tiered model mapping** (`GLM_MODEL_SONNET/OPUS/HAIKU` per-tier overrides over `GLM_MODEL`, fallback `glm-5.2`), plus `glm` appended to the auto-resolution chain. Recommend adopting upstream's hunks wholesale and retiring the local pin — it is a superset of what b054cb0 did.
2. **`.github/workflows/messages.yml`** — upstream binds `HERMES_AUTH` / `CURSOR_API_KEY` / `GLM_API_KEY` / `ZAI_API_KEY` into three env blocks and adds the `GLM_MODEL` var; your `b054cb0` edits touch the same blocks. Mechanical merge: take upstream's four lines into each block, keep your narrowing.
3. **`.github/workflows/aeon.yml`** (carried since 08-25) — upstream +103/−13 across 6 commits (harness matrix for cursor/hermes/glm, gateway provider plumbing, `fx` workflow dispatches #982); your narrowed env/secrets block overlaps them.
4. **`.github/workflows/ci-tests.yml`** (carried) — upstream +12: tests for the new harness adapters.
5. **`CHANGELOG.md`** (carried) — upstream +67: entries through #996. Yours has local history interleaved.
6. **`.github/README.md`** (carried) — ~20 lines of ecosystem/docs churn. *(One line touched here: the "Full catalog — all N skills by pack" caption bumped 81→84, because the catalog regen in this PR trips `ci-readme-catalog` otherwise. Count-only, derived; the rest of the file is untouched and still needs your manual merge.)*
7. **`llms.txt`** (carried) — 4 lines (skill-count + harness list).
8. **`docs/skill-packs.md`** (carried) — 4 lines (cortx-reliability pack entry — you may just want this one line even without the rest).

### Operator config changed upstream (not auto-applied — reconcile by hand)

- **`aeon.yml`** — comment-only (+3/−2): upstream documented the `glm` gateway provider in the gateway block (auto-order now ends `… grok → glm`, explicit pin list includes `glm`, notes the Z.AI Anthropic endpoint and `GLM_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`). Worth copying the comment so the pin you already run matches canon's docs.

### Dropped from `pending_conflicts` (resolved this run)

- `skills/rightstack/**`, `skills/skill-article/**` — applied here (eyebrow pipeline now runs in-run).
- `apps/dashboard/package.json`(+lock), `apps/webhook/package.json`(+lock) — you reconciled these on the #198 branch; the remaining delta is your *newer* dep versions (e.g. `next` 16.3.1 vs upstream 16.2.12), not unmerged upstream work.
- `apps/dashboard/lib/skill-icons.data.ts` — regenerated by the icon pipeline; the generator owns it.
